title: Skip enabling incomplete existing retention policies on install/upgrade
summary: Skip enabling incomplete retention policies during install and upgrade when the existing setup would fail validation, preventing tenant upgrades from blocking on Dataverse Entity Change records with missing retention periods.
key_points: Guard skips enabling retention policy when record is already enabled, applies to all records without a retention period, or uses filters with no enabled lines
Preserves customer's existing incomplete setup instead of blocking upgrade with validation error
Added read permission on Retention Policy Setup Line to codeunit 3999
Changed EnableRetentionPolicySetup from local to internal visibility for testing
Covers Dataverse Entity Change, Integration Synch. Job and Integration Synch. Job Errors tables
